newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING-Cal Dive at $15, top of range.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING-Cal Dive at $15, top of range.

text.p: Company Name Cal Dive International Inc
NOTE: Price range was revised higher to $14-$15 from an earlier range of $12 to $14.
Cal Dive provides sub-sea construction, inspection, maintenance, repair and salvage services to the offshore natural gas and oil industry in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico.

It filed for an IPO in September but withdrew the proposed offering for undisclosed reason. In April, Cal Dive sold a 32 percent stake in the company to an affiliate of Paris-based Coflexip SA for $35 million.
The two companies formed a joint venture to pursue engineering, procurement, installationa dn commissioning projects in deep-water oil and gas fields in the Gulf of Mexico.
